title: Selling Plans Administration Fee on Repeat Seller Cancellations
content:
A seller who cancels orders repeatedly has an administration fee withheld from a **Selling Plans** cancellation credit. The rule reads the seller cancellation defects and the performance level on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record.

**Rule.** A cancellation administration fee is withheld when the standing record shows at least the repeat-cancellation count of seller cancellation defects dated within the cancellation record window: at the top-level cancellation admin rate when the seller's performance level is one of the discount standing levels, and at the other-level cancellation admin rate when the level is any other level; with fewer seller cancellation defects in that period no cancellation administration fee is withheld.

The cancellation administration fee is the cancellation credit before the fee times the rate, rounded to the nearest cent, and then held to the cap; the cancellation credit booked is the credit before the fee less that fee.

The discount standing levels are Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level.

## Rate matrix

| Seller cancellation defects dated within the cancellation record window | Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | Any other level |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more (the repeat-cancellation count) | 5% (top-level cancellation admin rate) | 10% (other-level cancellation admin rate) |
| Fewer than 2 | No fee withheld | No fee withheld |

## Worked figures (hypothetical; credit before the fee USD 26.40, cap not reached)

- Two seller cancellation defects in the window, Top Rated Level: 5% of 26.40 is USD 1.32; credit booked USD 25.08.
- Three defects, Standard Level: 10% of 26.40 is USD 2.64; credit booked USD 23.76.
- One defect, any level: no fee withheld; credit booked USD 26.40.
